map.title: Category mapping
map.desc: KFC / Brazco website categories → 7 groups; right side is items · season sales.
map.rules: 1. Names containing “Costume” always go to Costumes. 2. Otherwise by supplier category keywords. 3. KFC theme series (Witch, Vampire, Creepy Clown, Zombie, Devil, Asylum…) and uncategorised items go by product-name keywords; anything unrecognised lands in Accessories & props.

footer.title: Definitions
footer.scope: Halloween items = our HalloWeen category and sub-categories supplied by KFC / Brazco ({{count}} items); sales come from the daily item-store statistics (incl. GST, refunds netted).
footer.purchase: Purchases = this year’s store invoices (Mar 1 – Oct 31, excluding warehouse 1006, drafts included). Leftover = purchases − season sales; the system has no store stock field, so last year’s stock is not included.
footer.sellThrough: Sell-through only counts items a store actually bought this year, so selling old stock does not inflate it.
footer.soldOut: Sold out = a store’s cumulative sales of an item reach 95% of its purchases (not judged under 3 units); days early = 10/31 − sell-out day; lost sales = 14-day pre-sell-out daily average × days early × average price.
